remarks: Check out this newly renovated 1-bedroom apartment located in the heart of downtown Greenwich! Enjoy the best of in-town living with shops, restaurants, the train station, and parks all just steps away. The unit features modern updates throughout and offers a bright, comfortable space to call home. Pets are welcome at the owner's discretion (sorry, no aggressive breeds) with a $45 monthly pet fee. Parking is available for an additional cost. Applicants must have a minimum credit score of 650, and a $27 application fee is required for all individuals over 18. To move in, first month's rent and one month's security deposit are due. Household gross monthly income must be at least three times the rental amount. Tenants are responsible for gas and electric utilities. Professionally leased by Robert C. White & Company Broker, Robert C. White & Company.
